# The English Channels

> The English Channels is an Austin, TX based musical collective performing the music of The Cure, Joy Division, New Order, Echo & the Bunnymen, Interpol, and more. The project operates as two distinct live shows: **The Cure Tribute** (a dedicated tribute to The Cure) and **Lost Control** (post-punk, new wave, and darkwave covers).

The site is a static HTML/CSS/JS marketing and booking site. Upcoming show listings are pulled dynamically from a shared Google Sheets CSV. Contact forms submit to Basin. Booking inquiries should be directed to booking@theenglishchannels.com.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://theenglishchannels.com/): Landing page with split sections for The Cure Tribute and Lost Control, and upcoming shows for both projects.
- [About](https://theenglishchannels.com/about/): About The English Channels and its members.
- [Contact](https://theenglishchannels.com/contact/): General contact form and booking email.

## The Cure Tribute

- [The Cure Tribute — Home](https://theenglishchannels.com/thecuretribute/): Project home page.
- [About](https://theenglishchannels.com/thecuretribute/about/): About the Cure Tribute show.
- [Shows](https://theenglishchannels.com/thecuretribute/shows/): Upcoming Cure Tribute performances.
- [Videos](https://theenglishchannels.com/thecuretribute/videos/): Live performance videos.
- [Photos](https://theenglishchannels.com/thecuretribute/photos/): Photo gallery.
- [Contact](https://theenglishchannels.com/thecuretribute/contact/): Booking and contact form.

## Lost Control

- [Lost Control — Home](https://theenglishchannels.com/lostcontrol/): Project home page (post-punk / new wave / darkwave covers including Joy Division, New Order, Echo & the Bunnymen, Interpol).
- [Shows](https://theenglishchannels.com/lostcontrol/shows/): Upcoming Lost Control performances.
- [Videos](https://theenglishchannels.com/lostcontrol/videos/): Live performance videos.
- [Photos](https://theenglishchannels.com/lostcontrol/photos/): Photo gallery.
- [Contact](https://theenglishchannels.com/lostcontrol/contact/): Booking and contact form.
